name: Skyforged Tempest Alloy
description: A storm-charged alloy quenched in upper-atmosphere winds.
specialEffects: Used in aegises, lightning wards, and tempest-hardened plating.

steps: Refine raw stock for Skyforged Tempest Alloy under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Skyforged Refinery protocol before storage.
